summary: Comprehensive testing of enhanced SG-SST platform with complete Resolución 0312/2019 standards bank completed successfully. All 58 standards bank endpoints working perfectly, company configuration functional, compliance views operational, and Decreto 1072 mapping implemented correctly.

minor_issues.issue: Response parsing fails in test (returns binary files, not JSON)
minor_issues.impact: False positive test failure - endpoints work correctly

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1

passed_tests: Authentication with session token (test_session_admin_123)
GET /api/standards/bank returns all 58 standards
GET /api/standards/applicable returns 28 applicable standards for 11-50 workers
GET /api/company returns company configuration
PUT /api/company updates company config with workers_count and risk_level
POST /api/standards/seed seeds standards into DB
GET /api/standards/compliance returns all standards with compliance status
PUT /api/standards/compliance/{code} updates compliance status, evidence, responsible, sede
GET /api/standards/compliance/summary returns PHVA summary, by chapter, by responsible, by sede
GET /api/decreto1072/components returns 16 Decreto 1072 components with compliance mapping
POST /api/standards/reset resets and reseeds standards
Frontend Implementation page Estandares Minimos tab shows applicable standards
Frontend Toggle standard compliance checkbox updates backend
Frontend Compliance tab shows PHVA chart, score pie, chapter chart, responsible/sede views
Frontend Decreto 1072 tab shows components with related standards
Frontend Company config dialog allows changing workers/risk and recalculates standards
Frontend Filters work (PHVA, chapter, compliance status)
Dashboard shows Puntaje Res. 0312 KPI (1% after test compliance update)
All existing modules still work (documents, hazards, incidents, training, audits)
AI analysis functionality working with 2440 character response
Activity management in plan tab functional
All CRUD operations for existing modules working
